title: 1994 AMC 8 Problem 2
statement:
What is the value of the following expression?

\[ \begin{aligned} &\frac{1}{10} + \frac{2}{10} + \frac{3}{10} + \frac{4}{10} \\ &\quad {}+ \frac{5}{10} + \frac{6}{10} + \frac{7}{10} + \frac{8}{10} \\ &\quad {}+ \frac{9}{10} + \frac{55}{10} \end{aligned} \]

solutions.text:
The numerators sum to \(1 + 2 + \cdots + 9 + 55\) \(= 45 + 55\) \(= 100.\)

So the total is \(\dfrac{100}{10} = 10.\)

Thus, the correct answer is D .
hints: All the terms share the denominator \(10\), so add the numerators first
